proposedchanges.title: Trump Reportedly Drops Support for Immediate Ukraine Ceasefire After Putin Meeting
proposedchanges.description_long: After meeting Russian President Vladimir Putin in Alaska on August 15, 2025, Donald Trump reportedly told European leaders he no longer supported an immediate ceasefire in Ukraine. He instead urged Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to consider ceding territory Russia had not conquered. The report described this as a change from earlier calls for a ceasefire, but did not specify which territory was discussed or give each leader’s response. The reported position was not an agreement with Ukraine. It changed the terms under discussion after the meeting but did not settle Ukraine’s position or the outcome of negotiations.
